question_text: Across all crowd-mode cameras (ExpoFloor_MainAisle, DemoBooth_NVIDIA, DemoBooth_Intel, KeynoteHall_Stage, FoodCourt_North) on 2025-12-08 (UTC), which location showed the most extreme peak-to-baseline contrast — meaning the largest ratio of its peak head_count to its overnight quiet-hour average head_count? Identify the camera_location and explain the ratio order of magnitude.
answer_text: KeynoteHall_Stage showed the most extreme contrast on 2025-12-08 (UTC): peak_head_count 500 vs overnight_baseline_avg 7.085, ratio 70.57163020465772 (camera_location: KeynoteHall_Stage). The ratio’s order of magnitude is approx 10^1 (tens).

citations.cypher:
WITH '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AS dayStart, '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' AS dayEnd,
     '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AS overnightStart, '2025-12-08T06:00:00Z' AS overnightEnd,
     ['ExpoFloor_MainAisle','DemoBooth_NVIDIA','DemoBooth_Intel','KeynoteHall_Stage','FoodCourt_North'] AS locs
MATCH (c:Camera)
WHERE c.mode = 'crowd' AND c.camera_location IN locs
OPTIONAL MATCH (ch_day:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c)
WHERE ch_day.hour_utc >= dayStart AND ch_day.hour_utc < dayEnd
WITH c, max(ch_day.peak_hc) AS day_peak, overnightStart, overnightEnd
OPTIONAL MATCH (ch_night:CrowdHour)-[:AT_CAMERA]->(c)
WHERE ch_night.hour_utc >= overnightStart AND ch_night.hour_utc < overnightEnd
WITH c, day_peak,
     sum(ch_night.avg_hc * ch_night.event_count) AS sum_hc,
     sum(ch_night.event_count) AS total_samples
WITH c.camera_location AS camera_location,
     coalesce(day_peak, 0.0) AS peak_head_count,
     CASE WHEN coalesce(total_samples,0) > 0 THEN coalesce(sum_hc,0.0) / total_samples ELSE 0.0 END AS overnight_baseline_avg
WITH camera_location, peak_head_count, overnight_baseline_avg,
     CASE WHEN overnight_baseline_avg > 0 THEN peak_head_count / overnight_baseline_avg ELSE null END AS ratio
WITH camera_location, peak_head_count, overnight_baseline_avg, ratio,
     CASE
       WHEN ratio IS NULL AND peak_head_count > 0 THEN 'infinite (baseline ~ 0)'
       WHEN ratio IS NULL AND peak_head_count = 0 THEN 'no data'
       WHEN ratio = 0 THEN 'no contrast (peak=0)'
       ELSE 'approx 10^' + toString(toInteger(floor(log10(ratio))))
     END AS order_of_magnitude,
     CASE
       WHEN ratio IS NULL AND peak_head_count > 0 THEN 1000000000000.0
       WHEN ratio IS NULL AND peak_head_count = 0 THEN 0.0
       ELSE ratio
     END AS sort_key
RETURN camera_location, peak_head_count, overnight_baseline_avg, ratio, order_of_magnitude
ORDER BY sort_key DESC
LIMIT 1
